 BATTLEFIELD 6 GAME UPDATE 2.1.2.5
 November 25, 2026
 
 
 
 

 Game Update 2.1.2.5 rolls out across Battlefield 6 and REDSEC tomorrow, Thursday 26th, delivering targeted improvements to the Supply Pouch, UI presentation, AI navigation, and overall match stability.

 At 09:00 UTC, players will be able to download the update across all platforms and jump in with the latest gameplay changes.

 CHANGELOG

 PLAYER: 

 General crash fixes across Battlefield 6 and REDSEC.
 
 GADGETS: 

 Reduced the delay before firing a weapon after throwing a Supply Pouch.
 
 MAPS & MODES: 

 Resolved an issue on European Casino where a flag could remain floating after its flagpole was destroyed.
 
 UI & HUD: 

 Resolved an issue in the menus where Heist mode tiles displayed two subtitles.
 
 AI: 

 Bots can now climb ladders as intended on Vegas Strip.
 
 REDSEC

 UI & HUD: 

 Supply Pouches now display their intended in-world icon.
 
 This announcement may change as we listen to community feedback and continue developing and evolving our Live Service & Content. We will always strive to keep our community as informed as possible.
